def insertion_sort(records):
    result = records.copy()
    shifts = 0
    for i in range(1, len(result)):
        item = result[i]
        j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 and result[j][0] > item[0]:
            result[j + 1] = result[j]
            shifts += 1
            j -= 1
        result[j + 1] = item
    return result, shifts
print(insertion_sort([(1, "Z"), (1, "A"), (0, "B")]))
